paragraphs: Early in the morning, review drawings and prepare a cut list. Use a table saw to cut stock and rout profiles during the morning. After midday, join and glue parts and install hardware. In the afternoon, sand and stain amid the smell of sawdust. Toward evening, visit a customer's home to verify measurements and adjust door gaps, leaving the apron covered in sawdust.
